Explanation goes something like this. Two Posts, yes. Each Post will connect two positive, two negative so you can do a dual-coil build. You can remove the posts and use the holes at the bottom for a "postless" build consisting of one beefy coil like a clapton or alien clapton. I think that's what you're referring to in your response. I have the Wotofo Freakshow which is a three-post deck. Three-post decks tend to be harder on which to build because two leads are emerging through the hole in the center post and you can't or shouldn't clip leads right away. You have to get down in there with nippy cutters to get the lead clipped so it doesn't touch your coil while being careful not to cut the other coil. This post style (velocity post) makes building much easier. Plus the Freakshow tends to leak through the airflow holes at the bottom if you're not careful with dripping. Not so much a problem with this particular mutation as it has side and top airflow holes. I paid about $25 for the Freakshow and, from the look of things, $10 on the Mutation is an upgrade. I took a look at one through a local vape shop or two and the owners confirmed that, if this thing leaks in any way, you're just using too much liquid.

I think my problem with the Freakshow is that I've tried using it as a DTL Atty and it's just not cutting it, it seems like the airflow, even wide open is acting like more of a MTL due to it's rather restrictive air flow.
